career_ladder.note: Civil Judge (Junior Division) cum Judicial Magistrate First Class (JMFC) is the entry cadre (Grade-III) of the Assam Judicial Service, administered under the Assam Judicial Service Rules and High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram & Arunachal Pradesh (Gauhati High Court) regulations. Upward progression to senior subordinate and higher judicial cadres follows merit-cum-seniority and Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE) quotas in accordance with Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) scales and Supreme Court mandates.

exam_scheme.note: The direct recruitment examination for Grade-III of Assam Judicial Service is conducted by the Gauhati High Court in three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Screening Test of 100 objective marks for shortlisting in a 1:10 ratio), Main Written Examination consisting of 5 papers (4 core papers of 100 marks each + 1 qualifying official language paper of 50 marks, with 1:3 shortlisting ratio for interview), followed by Viva-Voce / Interview (50 marks). Final merit list is prepared on the aggregate marks secured in the Main Written Examination (Papers I to IV, 400 marks) and Interview (50 marks), totaling 450 marks.

stages.source_label: Gauhati High Court Advt dated 06.02.2023, Clause 3(a)-(b) & Preliminary Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Objective Law Screening Test (90 marks: GK, Aptitude, English, Constitution, CPC, CrPC, Transfer of Property, Contract Act, IPC, Evidence Act, Law of Torts + 10 marks: Assamese Proficiency)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 60% qualifying marks; candidates shortlisted in 1:10 ratio for Main Written Examination

stages.source_label: Gauhati High Court Advt dated 06.02.2023, Clause 3(c)-(d) & Main Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Paper I: English (Essay Writing, Precis Writing, Grammar etc.)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 45% marks in individual paper (40% for SC/ST)

papers.paper_name: Paper II: General Knowledge (Objective Type & Aptitude Test)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 45% marks in individual paper (40% for SC/ST)

papers.paper_name: Paper III: Law Paper I (Constitution of India, Code of Civil Procedure, Transfer of Property Act, Indian Contract Act)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 45% marks in individual paper (40% for SC/ST)

papers.paper_name: Paper IV: Law Paper II (Indian Penal Code, Criminal Procedure Code, Indian Evidence Act, Law of Torts)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 45% marks in individual paper (40% for SC/ST). Overall aggregate across Papers I-IV: 60% (50% for SC/ST)

papers.paper_name: Paper V: Proficiency in the Official Language(s) of the State of Assam (Assamese)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 35% marks required (qualifying in nature; marks not added to final aggregate)

stages.source_label: Gauhati High Court Advt dated 06.02.2023, Clause 3(e) & Final Evaluation Norms

papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 60% marks (30 out of 50 marks) required in the interview for inclusion in final merit list

financial_package.note: Civil Judges (Junior Division) / JMFC in Assam are remunerated in accordance with the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) revised scales implemented nationwide pursuant to Supreme Court directives in All India Judges Association v. Union of India. The entry pay scale is SNJPC J-1 (₹77,840 – ₹1,36,520) with an entry basic pay of ₹77,840 per month.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Gauhati High Court Notification No. HC.XXXVII-03/2023/39/R.Cell read with SNJPC Revised Judicial Scales
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on SNJPC J-1 entry basic pay of ₹77,840 with standardized 58% Dearness Allowance plus HRA / designated judicial residential accommodation and fixed judicial allowances (sumptuary, robe, medical, conveyance); in-hand estimate deducts 10% NPS pension contribution, GIS, and professional tax.
official_perks: Designated government residential bungalow / judicial quarters or admissible HRA
Official vehicle / conveyance allowance with driver and fuel reimbursement as per SNJPC norms
Sumptuary allowance for official judicial entertainment and protocol
Robe and uniform allowance provided periodically
Telephone, mobile, and high-speed broadband internet reimbursements
Comprehensive medical facilities and reimbursement under State Judicial Service Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and home town travel concessions
